description: What it does: Sends your question or task to an agent on our A2A network: the agent you name, the best fit by its agent card, or a Society agent when no other agent fits. Call it when: you need a specific agent's skill, e.g. open ICU nurse jobs in Texas or a short instrumental music track; you want an analysis from a domain agent faster than a Beyond Obvious answer. Not for: you want the options a generic answer misses, with a source for every number (use Beyond Obvious). In/out: In: text (+ optional metadata.agent_id or metadata.capability) · Out: a Task with the agent's answer. Agent list with each agent's card: https://agentbazaar.tech/explore/agents.json. Returns the answer, or a task id for get_answer. Pass your agent's api_key (ak_...); without one a new key is created and shown once. Usage is recorded per key.

capability.description: Optional: invoke the top agent for this skill/capability

wait_seconds.description: Optional: how long to wait in this call (0-50, default 50)

name: invoke
